search_leads_not_treated_as_evidence: Wikipedia/Wikibooks and derived wikis state Visual Basic 4.0 was released in August 1995 and Visual C++ 4.0 on 11 December 1995; no first-party source for either exact date was reached.

Wikipedia and PowerBuilder fan blogs place PowerBuilder 4.0 in 1994 and one states 5.0 was released in 1995; the 1996 GCN article contradicts the latter. No first-party PowerBuilder 4.0 ship date was reached.

method_note: Pages were read with a web fetch tool. The Sun press release PDF was cached by the fetch tool in the session tool-results folder outside the repository. No third-party file, logo, box art or screenshot was added to the repository. No account was created and no terms were accepted.
